lang.description: Language code of this translation, used for <html lang>

extDescription.message: Overlay two live websites for pixel-perfect comparison: difference highlight, synced scroll, mirrored clicks and hover.

copyLinkTitle.message: Copy a link to this comparison

diffNowTitle.message: Recompute the difference if the page changed without scrolling

followRouteTitle.message: Navigating in one layer opens the same route in the other

hint.message: Alt+1 / Alt+2 — active layer · Alt+H — hide B · Alt+D — difference · Alt+T — toolbar

leftBase.message: $1 left its base URL, $2 stays where it is

notResponding.message: $1 is not responding: the site may block iframes with a script, or this tab needs a reload after installing the extension

linkHold.message: Link opened from a website. Check the URLs and press “Load”

optSub.message: Changes are saved right away and apply to open comparison tabs.

optWidthsDesc.message: Buttons in the Width group. Click a width to remove it.

optNoWidths.message: No buttons: only the number field stays.

optWidthRange.message: Enter a width from $1 to $2 px

optWidthExists.message: $1 px is already in the list

optModesDesc.message: Modes you don't use disappear from the toolbar. At least one stays on.

optModeOverlayDesc.message: B on top of A with adjustable opacity

optModeHighlightDesc.message: Overlay with the changes pulsing in colour

optModeDifferenceDesc.message: Matching pixels turn black, changes glow

optModeSideDesc.message: Both sites next to each other at the chosen width

optFeaturesDesc.message: A feature that is off is hidden from the toolbar and never runs.

optSyncScrollDesc.message: Scrolling one site scrolls the other, by pixels or by page height

optFollowDesc.message: Opening another page in one site opens the same route in the other

optMirrorClicksDesc.message: Buttons, links and menus pressed in one site are pressed in the other

optMirrorHoverDesc.message: Hover effects and dropdown menus open in both sites

optMirrorInputDesc.message: Text typed in a field appears in the same field of the other site. Passwords never do

optOffsetDesc.message: Shift the top layer by X/Y, for example when headers differ in height

optHotkeysDesc.message: Alt+1 / Alt+2 active layer, Alt+H hide B, Alt+D difference, Alt+T toolbar. Off, these keys reach the sites

optLinksDesc.message: The copy link button, and opening site-overlay.invalid links as a comparison

optDiffColorDesc.message: Colour of the highlight in Highlight mode. Pick one that stands out on your sites

fitSideTitle.message: Side by side always fits the window

widthSliderTitle.message: Drag to any width between the breakpoints

mirrorPillTitle.message: Your clicks, hover and typing are repeated in the other site. Click to turn this off

mirrorNote.message: Clicks, hover and typing are repeated in the other site. These are real clicks: careful on production

welcomeStep1.message: Enter two addresses above: A is the bottom layer, B goes on top.

welcomeStep2.message: Add a shared route such as /pricing, or leave it empty.

welcomeStep3.message: Press Load, then pick a mode and a width.

fitNote.message: Scales the sites down when the width is larger than the window

updateTitle.message: Reload the extension to finish the update

reloadText.message: The files on disk are version $1, but Chrome is still running version $2, so the sites cannot connect to this page. Reloading closes this tab; click the extension icon to open your comparison again.
